rendering_contract: Candidate wording for S45 deterministic distribution rendering; each queried state has a branch, all probabilities remain visible. No probability threshold or posterior-ranked treatment selection is defined. Urgent banner renders from saved inputs in parallel with review topics. Whether outputs behave as deterministic rules or estimated tables is an open assumption for owner review; this wording assumes neither.
disclosures: Experimental, uncalibrated and unapproved; not a prescription.
A first-time case is not_applicable and claims no posterior; it is never a negative finding or a fake negative clozapine posterior.
Missing trial-adequacy or observation-window context pauses; a missing trial assessment is never mapped to No.
Urgent banner comes from saved structured urgent inputs, not model output, and never shows a fabricated risk percentage.
No dose, route, frequency or active/stopped fields are collected or accepted.
